7.stem_plain: James took part in a challenge and jogged every day ________ a week.

8.stem_plain: Last night, I ________ woken up by a loud clap of thunder.

9.stem_plain: Sarah and Jane ________ thrilled when they heard about the learning journey to the Singapore Zoo.

10.stem_plain: "We ________ now. Please come and join us," said Mr Ali.

11.stem_plain: Last night, Kim ________ a loaf of bread before going home for dinner.

12.stem_plain: When Julia ________ to the toilet, she spotted a beehive on the tree.

13.stem_plain: ________ seat here in front of the stage is reserved for the Guest of Honour.

14.stem_plain: Susan lost her favourite pen ________ she did not cry.

15.stem_plain: We need to prepare more food as we have invited ________ friends to our party.

16.stem_plain: "May I go to the water cooler? There's not ________ water left in my water bottle," Lila asked her teacher.

7.note: 表示动作持续了一段时间，后面接一段时间（a week），应该用介词 “for”。
7.concept: 介词辨析 — Prepositions — time duration
7.zh: 詹姆斯参加了一个挑战，连续一个星期每天都去跑步。

8.note: 句首有明确的过去时间状语 “Last night”（昨晚），且主语为 “I”（第一人称单数），被动语态中表示被吵醒应用 “was woken up”。
8.concept: 被动语态与时态 — Passive Voice & Tense — Past Tense (Singular)
8.zh: 昨晚，我被一声响亮的雷鸣惊醒了。

9.note: “when” 引导的时间状语从句使用的是过去时（heard），主句也应使用过去时；主语是 “Sarah and Jane”（复数），因此用 “were”。
9.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Plural)
9.zh: 当萨拉和珍听到去新加坡动物园的学习之旅时，她们兴奋不已。

10.note: 句中有时间副词 “now”（现在），表明说话人正在进行的动作，需用现在进行时 “are eating”。
10.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Present Continuous Tense
10.zh: “我们现在正在吃东西。请过来加入我们吧，”阿里先生说。

11.note: 句首有明确的过去时间状语 “Last night”（昨晚），表示过去发生的动作，需用一般过去时，buy 的过去式为 bought。
11.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Simple Past Tense
11.zh: 昨晚，金在回家吃晚饭前买了一长条面包。

12.note: “When” 引导的从句在此处表示一个正在持续的背景动作（在去厕所的路上），中途发生了一个瞬间动作（spotted），因此从句需用过去进行时 “was walking”。
12.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Past Continuous Tense
12.zh: 当朱莉娅走向厕所时，她发现树上有一个马蜂窝。

13.note: 句中有空间近指词 “here”（这里），且修饰的对象 “seat” 是单数可数名词，因此选用近指单数指示代词 “This”。
13.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — this
13.zh: 舞台前方的这个座位是为贵宾预留的。

14.note: 前半句“丢了最喜欢的笔”和后半句“没有哭”之间是转折关系，故选表示转折的连词 “but”。
14.zh: 苏珊丢 distributed 了她最喜欢的笔，但她没有哭。

15.note: “friends” 是可数名词复数，不能用 little 或 much 修饰；结合前文 “prepare more food”（准备更多食物），说明邀请的朋友“很多”，故选 many。
15.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — countable nouns
15.zh: 我们需要准备更多的食物，因为我们邀请了许多朋友来参加我们的派对。

16.note: “water” 是不可数名词，不能用 few 或 many 修饰；在否定句 “There's not...” 中，表示水“不多”，通常用 much 修饰。
16.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — uncountable nouns
16.zh: “我可以去饮水机那儿吗？我的水瓶里没剩多少水了，”莉拉问她的老师。

1.stem_plain: Vicky squealed with delight. She was ____________ to see the shiny new bicycle that her parents have bought for her.

2.stem_plain: Alison wrote a note in her diary to ____________ herself to revise for her spelling test on Thursday.

3.stem_plain: The eagle's ____________ to see clearly from far helps it find food from high up in the sky.

4.stem_plain: Grandfather's 80th birthday was the perfect ____________ to gather the whole family together for dinner.

5.stem_plain: "Mum, we need to fix this leaking tap. Little drops of water are ____________ from it," said Alex.

6.stem_plain: Wearing ____________ gear like a helmet or kneepads keeps us safe when cycling.

1.zh: 维琪高兴得叫了起来。看到父母给她买的崭新闪亮的自行车，她欣喜若狂。
1.note: “overjoyed”意思是“欣喜若狂的”，与前文的“高兴得叫了起来（squealed with delight）”完美呼应。

choices.eg: She was upset when she lost her favorite watch at the park.
He felt confident that he would pass the driving test easily.
The team was overjoyed after winning the championship match.
They were disappointed that the outdoor concert was canceled due to rain.

2.zh: 艾莉森在日记里写了一条便签，以提醒自己复习周四的拼写测试。
2.note: “remind”意思是“提醒（某人）”，常用于“remind oneself to do something”结构，符合写便签备忘的场景。

choices.eg: The sign was put up to warn people about the deep water.
The teacher will advise the students on how to choose their project topics.
Please remind me to buy some milk on our way home.
The detective began to question the suspect about his whereabouts.

3.zh: 老鹰从远处清晰看物的能力有助于它在天空高处寻找食物。
3.note: “ability”意思是“能力”，后面常接动词不定式（ability to see），形容老鹰天生的生理本能。

choices.eg: Birds have the amazing ability to fly long distances across the ocean.
The engine has enough power to pull the heavy cargo train.
The driver lost control of the vehicle on the icy road.
Children have plenty of energy to run around all day.

4.zh: 祖父的80岁生日是让全家人聚在一起吃晚饭的绝佳时机。
4.note: “occasion”意思是“时机、重大活动、场合”，通常用来指代生日、婚礼等庆祝活动。

choices.eg: The police are monitoring the traffic situation on the expressway.
She sent out an invitation to her friends for her housewarming party.
A graduation ceremony is a memorable occasion for all students.
The boy gave a long explanation for why he was late for school.

5.zh: “妈妈，我们需要修理这个漏水的水龙头。小水滴正从里面滴下来，”亚历克斯说。
5.note: “dripping”意思是“滴下、滴水”，由漏水（leaking）以及前文的“小水滴（little drops of water）”可以准确锁定该词。

choices.zh: 渗出、慢慢流出（多指粘稠液体）
choices.eg: Sticky sap was oozing from the cut on the tree trunk.
Water was gushing out from the broken underground pipe.
Rainwater was dripping from the roof into the bucket below.
The water was sloshing around in the bucket as he carried it.

6.zh: 骑自行车时佩戴头盔或护膝等防护装备可以让我们保持安全。
6.note: “protective”意思是“保护性的、防护的”，常与“gear（装备）”搭配，指头盔、护膝等安全用品。

choices.eg: The school took proactive measures to prevent bullying among students.
Workers on the construction site must wear protective clothing at all times.
The team had a highly productive meeting and finalized the plan.

choices.zh: 防腐的（通常作名词指防腐剂）
choices.eg: Salt has been used for centuries as a natural preservative for meat.

zh: 这是词汇填空示例段落。

An example sentence with the Option2

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 作句子主语，指代上文提到的物‘小组项目（group project）’，单数中性代词用 it，故选 it。

18.note: 修饰名词短语 group members，指代 Emma 的组员们，用女性单数物主代词 her，故选 her。

19.note: 修饰名词短语 teamwork and creativity，表示‘他们的’团队合作与创意，故选 their。

20.note: 作从句主语，后面有 together（一起），结合前文‘老师表扬了他们’，说明是指代‘他们’共同取得的成就，故选 they。

cloze: Emma was excited to present her group project to the class. [Q17] was a model of the solar system, carefully made with colourful planets. She made the sun while [Q18] group members worked on the planets, making sure the sizes were accurate. Everyone admired [Q19] teamwork and creativity. The teacher praised them and she felt proud of what [Q20] had achieved together. It was a moment she would always remember.
zh: 埃玛很兴奋能向全班展示她的核心小组项目。它是一个太阳系的模型，是用色彩斑斓的行星精心制作而成的。她制作了太阳，而她的组员们则负责制作行星，以确保尺寸准确。每个人都赞赏他们的团队合作和创造力。老师表扬了他们，她为他们共同取得的成就感到自豪。这是一个她会永远铭记的时刻。

cloze: Prototype comprehension cloze: The sun lend me a [Q46(hend)] when I am down.

46.note: 完美契合经典口语及书面语习语 lend a hand，表示在需要时“伸出援手”或“搭把手”提供帮助。

29.stem_plain: Peter was listening to music. Peter's sister was talking on the phone.

30.stem_plain: Sarah was tired. Sarah stayed up late to finish her work.

31.stem_plain: The students arrive on time. We will start the lesson.

32.stem_plain: We can play soccer during recess. We can go to the library during recess.

29.concept: 时间状语从句 — Temporal Clause ('while')
29.zh: 皮特在听音乐，而他的妹妹在接电话。
29.note: while 引导时间状语从句，用于连接两个同时发生且具有对比或并行性质的过去进行时动作。
29.answer: Peter was listening to music while his sister was talking on the phone.

30.concept: 让步状语从补 — Concessive Clause ('Although')
30.zh: 虽然萨拉很累，但她还是熬夜完成了工作。
30.note: Although 引导让步状语从句。连接时需注意主句和从句使用同一个名词时，后出现的用代词（Sarah -> she）替换，且主从句间用逗号隔开，句中不能再出现 but。
30.answer: Although Sarah was tired, she stayed up late to finish her work.

31.concept: 条件状语从句 — Conditional Clause ('If')
31.zh: 如果学生们按时到达，我们就会开始上课。
31.note: If 引导条件从句。主句使用一般将来时（will start），if 从句使用一般现在时（arrive），主从句之间用逗号隔开。
31.answer: If the students arrive on time, we will start the lesson.

32.concept: 选择连词 — Correlative Conjunction ('either ... or ...')
32.zh: 我们在课间休息时要么踢足球，要么去图书馆。
32.note: 用 either ... or ... 连接两个选择项。合并时应省略第二句中重复的成分 'We can' 和 'during recess'，保持句子精炼。
32.answer: We can either play soccer or go to the library during recess.

paragraphs.1: 第一段从第1行开始，第一段的翻译。
